name: lexicon-mobile
description: Base de conhecimento pessoal com grafo de conceitos — mobile (Capacitor)

scripts.watch:web: mkdir -p dist && cp index.html dist/index.html && esbuild src/main.tsx --bundle --outfile=dist/main.js --watch
scripts.dev:web: mkdir -p dist && cp index.html dist/index.html && esbuild src/main.tsx --bundle --outfile=dist/main.js --servedir=dist --serve=${PORT:-5173} --watch
scripts.build:web: mkdir -p dist && cp index.html dist/index.html && esbuild src/main.tsx --bundle --outfile=dist/main.js --minify
scripts.sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync
scripts.open:ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.open:android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
